notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content: Added "[b]How to play[/b]" section in main menu to describe most of the main aspects of the game.

notes.title: Day 1 patch
notes.content:
Bug fix
-Resource Icon no longer is grayed out after randomizing map while "Resource Fog" setting is active
-Friendly scout should now reveal to all teams for all fog settings
-Friendly scout will no longer scout on a desert hexagon
-Should now correctly show team colors and player profile picture after match starts

Additional notes
-Adjusted a few UI elements
